note: Profile views of checked test profiles, projected by intlify_config, with their profile semantic digests. An independent implementation checks every view against 015's closed number-free shape: one member for each of the committed Profile Specification's semanticGroups, in its order; exact references of the kind 017 expects in each slot; the bounds its resourceBounds lists, as decimal strings; sets in ascending UTF-8 byte order; a decision row for every requested locale; each target's effective default; and the targets partitioned among the groups, each hydration relation inside its group. It recomputes each digest as 017's H under localization-project-profile-semantic-digest and checks that distinct views have distinct digests. Each case names the view its test inputs project, so the cases that share a view are declarations of one profile. None of these profiles is one a project declares.
